description: This file defines an authentication store using Zustand for state management, integrating with Supabase for auth functions. It manages user session, profile, authentication state, and provides methods for sign-in, sign-up, password reset, password update, and sign-out.

methods.name: fetchProfile(userId)
methods.description: Asynchronous helper to fetch user profile information from the database based on user ID (currently a placeholder implementation).

methods.name: ensureSubscribed
methods.description: Initializes the auth subscription to Supabase, loads current session, and sets up auth state change listener.

methods.name: initAuthWatcher
methods.description: Starts the auth watcher and initializes the store with the current session and user info.

methods.name: cleanupAuthWatcher
methods.description: Removes the auth state change listener if active.

methods.name: signInWithPassword
methods.description: Signs in a user using email and password via Supabase.

methods.name: signUpWithPassword
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password; can specify an email redirect URL.

methods.name: sendPasswordReset
methods.description: Sends a password reset email to the specified address.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the current user and clears auth state.
